// compilationMode: so omitting this silently produces a FULL-compiled library. The Angular
Package Format requires PARTIAL for anything published: full compilation
bakes the current Angular version's instruction set into the output, so
the package breaks on a later Angular that changed those internals.
ng-packagr notices and injects a prepublishOnly script that aborts the
publish — which is a good backstop, but it fails at the last possible
moment. tools/verify-package-format.mjs asserts it at build time instead.
